hints.title: Prefix and Word Counters on Trie Nodes
hints.text: Each Trie node needs to track both how many words end at this node and how many words share this prefix.

hints.title: Incrementing Path Counters on Insertion
hints.text: increment the prefix count for every character traversed during insertion, and increment the word count at the terminal node.

hints.title: Decrementing Counters on Deletion
hints.text: during erasure, decrement both prefix counts along the path and terminal count at the final node.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Trie node maintains children map, word count, and prefix count.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning a raw list of strings for prefix matches requires O(N * L) time per query.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Trie allows O(L) insert, count, and erase operations where L is string length.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should maintain both prefix_count and word_count counters on each Trie node.
